preconditions.description: The number of favourite integers t is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= 10**18 for x_i in x)
preconditions.description: Each favourite integer x_i is between 1 and 10^18 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ' '.join('YES' if is_possible(x_i) else 'NO' for x_i in x)
postconditions.description: For each favourite integer x_i, output 'YES' if it is possible to build a tower with exactly x_i visible pips, otherwise 'NO'.
